raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":1050,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT SUM(installed_capacity) AS total_installed_capacity, SUM(annual_generation) AS total_annual_generation FROM energy.energy_station WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('44','45','50','51','52','53','54','61','62','63','64','65') AND energy_type_code <> 'PUMPED';"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"查询西电东送送端省份的总装机容量和总年发电量","tables":["MYSQL:energy.energy_station"],"columns":["installed_capacity","annual_generation","area_id","energy_type_code"]}],"assumptions":["西电东送送端省份按送端省级行政区划代码识别，包括内蒙古(15)、广西(45)、四川(51)、云南(53)、贵州(52)、西藏(54)、陕西(61)、甘肃(62)、青海(63)、宁夏(64)、新疆(65)；其中内蒙古仅包含西部电网覆盖的蒙西地区，但行政区划代码无法区分蒙东与蒙西，故按整个内蒙古统计。","统计发电量时排除抽水蓄能电站（energy_type_code='PUMPED'），因其年发电量为0且功能为储能调峰。"]}
